attributes.board_name: Maryland State Board of Dental Examiners

rules.accepted_credit_types: Board-approved only. Automatically approved: courses by accredited dental/hygiene schools, ADA, NDA, ADHA, NDHA, AGD, AMA, AHA, Red Cross, ADA/AMA specialty societies, VA, US uniformed services, HHS, Maryland Dept. of Health and their components; courses approved by ADA CERP, AGD PACE, AADB ACE or AADH
rules.new_licensee_rule: Licensed within 6 months of graduating from an approved school: no CE for the first renewal.
rules.audit_note: Keep written documentation of completed CE for 5 years; the Board audits CE records (COMAR 10.44.22.14).

topics.who: Single 3-hour Board-approved course based on the CDC Summary of Infection Prevention Practices in Dental Settings
Board-approved course on abuse and neglect under Maryland law, every other renewal cycle
Current AHA BLS for Healthcare Providers, Red Cross Professional Rescuer or Board-approved equivalent

rules.notes: At least 13 hours in person or live webinar; max 17 hours self-study. Current CPR: AHA BLS for Healthcare Providers, Red Cross Professional Rescuer or Board-approved equivalent. CE period July 1 to June 30 of the renewal year. Optional: up to 8 h pro bono, 4 h cultural competency/military culture/implicit bias.
